# Ryan Madhuwala (RAWx18)

> AI Infrastructure Engineer, open-source maintainer, and founder of Caracal at Garudex Labs. One of the youngest Lab Leaders in Linux Foundation history. Backed by GitHub, Microsoft, Vercel and Founders, Inc. Based in Ahmedabad, India.

Portfolio: https://ryanmadhuwala.tech

## About

- Engineer / Artist. Loves building, breaking, and shipping things.
- Focus: AI infrastructure, AI agent security, open source, developer tools.
- Third-year BTech dropout from IIIT Gwalior (Computer Science, 2023-2025, CGPA 7.8, JEE 99.1 percentile). Chose the market over the classroom for a two-year head start building a startup.
- Cohort member: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund 2026, Microsoft for Startups, Vercel Open Source Program Spring'26, Founders Inc. Canopy Online.
- Lab Leader and LFX Mentor at LF Decentralized Trust (formerly Hyperledger Foundation). Ex-DRDO (Defence Ministry of India).
- Speaker/attendee: Open Source Summit Korea, Japan, India and North America; OpenSearchCon Europe, China and Korea; GitHub Maintainer Summit 2026; GitHub Open Source Friday.
- Winner: Smart India Hackathon. Finalist: Walmart Sparkathon 2025. Co-organizer: OpenSearch User Group Ahmedabad.

## Projects

- [Caracal](https://ryanmadhuwala.tech/projects/caracal): Authority, not credentials, for AI agents. Agents carry short-lived signed mandates that can only narrow as work is delegated; a gateway injects the real credential at call time. Default-deny policy decides every action before it runs, revocation propagates in one call, and an append-only tamper-evident trail exports for SOC 2, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and OWASP Agentic reviews. Standards-native: OAuth 2.0 token exchange (RFC 8693), OPA, MCP. Site: https://www.caracal.run. Repo: https://github.com/Garudex-Labs/caracal. Stack: Go, TypeScript, Python, Docker, OPA, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure, AWS, Redis, PostgreSQL.
- [GitMesh](https://ryanmadhuwala.tech/projects/gitmesh): Capacity-aware product intelligence layer for engineering teams. Normalises developer signals from nine platforms into one model, then deduplicates, classifies and ranks them by real community demand. 14 deployable services, 19 shared libraries, 312 API endpoints, 92 PostgreSQL tables, ~300k lines of code. Became an LF Decentralized Trust lab. Repo: https://github.com/LF-Decentralized-Trust-labs/gitmesh. Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue, Python, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, OpenSearch, Redis, Temporal.

### Programmes and cohorts

- [GitHub Secure Open Source Fund](https://ryanmadhuwala.tech/experience/github/secure-open-source-fund) — Apr 2026 to present. 2026 cohort: 72 maintainers, 50 projects, 22 countries, alongside FastAPI, LangChain, ONNX and OpenCLAW. Reached OpenSSF Scorecard above 8, OpenSSF Best Practices gold badge and ~80% test and fuzz coverage.

Grew from a side project to an LF Decentralized Trust lab approved by five TAC members; 100+ GitHub stars; used across LFDT, Jaeger, Cartography and Krkn (CNCF), the Linux kernel community, Intel Open Source and AIFAQ.

At Scientific Analysis Group, Ministry of Defence: proposed an Enhanced Adaptive Quantum Genetic Algorithm for multi-chain mining allocation, validated to a 0.00% gap against the derived closed-form optimum.
